tables.name: activities
tables.DDL:
CREATE TABLE activities (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'running', 'cancelled')),
    scope_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (scope_revision > 0),
    execution_generation INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (execution_generation >= 0),
    executor_id VARCHAR(128),
    lease_expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    deadline_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    max_requests INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (max_requests > 0),
    requests_reserved INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (requests_reserved >= 0 AND requests_reserved <= max_requests),
    max_cost_microunits BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (max_cost_microunits > 0),
    cost_reserved_microunits BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (
        cost_reserved_microunits >= 0 AND cost_reserved_microunits <= max_cost_microunits
    ),
    reserve_cost_microunits BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (
        reserve_cost_microunits > 0 AND reserve_cost_microunits <= max_cost_microunits
    ),
    max_request_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (max_request_bytes > 0),
    max_output_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (max_output_tokens > 0),
    allowed_tools VARCHAR(64)[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    cancelled_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    CHECK (cardinality(allowed_tools) <= 32),
    CHECK (
        (status = 'running' AND executor_id IS NOT NULL AND lease_expires_at IS NOT NULL)
        OR status <> 'running'
    )
);

tables.name: activity_operations
tables.DDL:
CREATE TABLE activity_operations (
    activity_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES activities(id),
    operation_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    admission_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    executor_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    execution_generation INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (execution_generation >= 0),
    scope_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (scope_revision > 0),
    provider VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    configured_model VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    request_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (request_bytes > 0),
    max_output_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (max_output_tokens > 0),
    tool_names VARCHAR(64)[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    reserved_cost_microunits BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (reserved_cost_microunits > 0),
    state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'reserved' CHECK (state IN ('reserved', 'dispatched', 'not_sent', 'received', 'unknown')),
    disposition TEXT CHECK (disposition IN ('not_sent', 'received', 'unknown')),
    error_code VARCHAR(64),
    remote_request_id VARCHAR(128),
    returned_model VARCHAR(128),
    finish_reason VARCHAR(64),
    prompt_tokens INTEGER CHECK (prompt_tokens >= 0),
    completion_tokens INTEGER CHECK (completion_tokens >= 0),
    response_bytes INTEGER CHECK (response_bytes >= 0 AND response_bytes <= 67108864),
    reserved_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    dispatch_started_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    recorded_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    PRIMARY KEY (activity_id, operation_id),
    CHECK (cardinality(tool_names) <= 32),
    CHECK ((state IN ('reserved', 'dispatched') AND disposition IS NULL) OR state = disposition),
    CHECK ((state = 'reserved' AND dispatch_started_at IS NULL) OR state <> 'reserved'),
    CHECK ((state IN ('not_sent', 'received', 'unknown') AND recorded_at IS NOT NULL) OR state IN ('reserved', 'dispatched'))
);

tables.DDL:
CREATE TABLE teaching_heads (
    activity_id UUID PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES activities(id),
    revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (revision BETWEEN 0 AND 2147483647),
    goal_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (goal_version BETWEEN 0 AND 32),
    last_seq INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (last_seq BETWEEN 0 AND 4096),
    phase TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'needs_goal' CHECK (phase IN
        ('needs_goal','needs_plan','path_review','ready','exercise_ready','answer_saved','feedback_ready')),
    goal_record_id UUID,
    path_record_id UUID,
    node_id VARCHAR(2) CHECK (node_id IS NULL OR node_id ~ '^n[1-6]$'),
    exercise_record_id UUID,
    answer_record_id UUID,
    feedback_record_id UUID,
    reason_record_id UUID,
    pending_business_key UUID,
    projection TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}' CHECK (octet_length(projection) BETWEEN 2 AND 8192),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    CHECK ((goal_version = 0 AND goal_record_id IS NULL AND phase = 'needs_goal')
        OR (goal_version > 0 AND goal_record_id IS NOT NULL AND phase <> 'needs_goal')),
    CHECK ((path_record_id IS NULL AND node_id IS NULL) OR
        (path_record_id IS NOT NULL AND node_id IS NOT NULL)),
    CHECK (answer_record_id IS NULL OR exercise_record_id IS NOT NULL),
    CHECK (feedback_record_id IS NULL OR answer_record_id IS NOT NULL)
);

tables.DDL:
CREATE TABLE teaching_commands (
    activity_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES activities(id),
    business_key UUID NOT NULL,
    action TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (action IN
        ('goal','plan','accept_path','exercise','expose','answer','calculate','evaluate',
         'correct','abandon','select_node')),
    request_sha256 CHAR(64) NOT NULL CHECK (request_sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
    request_body TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (octet_length(request_body) BETWEEN 2 AND 32768),
    slot_sha256 CHAR(64) NOT NULL CHECK (slot_sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
    expected_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (expected_revision BETWEEN 0 AND 2147483647),
    goal_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (goal_version BETWEEN 0 AND 32),
    scope_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (scope_revision > 0),
    parent_record_id UUID,
    context_body TEXT CHECK (context_body IS NULL OR octet_length(context_body) BETWEEN 2 AND 49152),
    context_sha256 CHAR(64) CHECK (context_sha256 IS NULL OR context_sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
    operation_id VARCHAR(128) CHECK (operation_id IS NULL OR
        (char_length(operation_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND operation_id !~ '[^A-Za-z0-9._:/-]')),
    retry_of UUID,
    status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN
        ('accepted','started','committed','history','not_sent','failed','unknown','abandoned')),
    launch_claimed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    obsolete_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    abandoned_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    result_record_id UUID,
    error_code VARCHAR(64) CHECK (error_code IS NULL OR error_code ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9._:/-]{1,64}$'),
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    PRIMARY KEY (activity_id,business_key),
    UNIQUE (activity_id,operation_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (activity_id,retry_of) REFERENCES teaching_commands(activity_id,business_key),
    CHECK ((context_body IS NULL) = (context_sha256 IS NULL)),
    CHECK ((action IN ('plan','exercise','evaluate','calculate') AND operation_id IS NOT NULL)
        OR (action NOT IN ('plan','exercise','evaluate','calculate') AND operation_id IS NULL)),
    CHECK (launch_claimed_at IS NULL OR action IN ('plan','exercise','evaluate','calculate')),
    CHECK (status <> 'started' OR launch_claimed_at IS NOT NULL)
);

tables.name: teaching_records
tables.DDL:
CREATE TABLE teaching_records (
    activity_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES activities(id),
    record_id UUID NOT NULL,
    seq INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (seq BETWEEN 1 AND 4096),
    kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN
        ('goal','path_proposal','path_accept','exercise','exposure','answer','calculation',
         'feedback','progress','correction','node_selection')),
    business_key UUID NOT NULL,
    ordinal SMALLINT NOT NULL CHECK (ordinal BETWEEN 1 AND 4),
    goal_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (goal_version BETWEEN 1 AND 32),
    scope_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (scope_revision > 0),
    goal_record_id UUID,
    parent_record_id UUID,
    exercise_record_id UUID,
    answer_record_id UUID,
    supersedes_record_id UUID,
    operation_id VARCHAR(128),
    body TEXT CHECK (body IS NULL OR octet_length(body) BETWEEN 2 AND 32768),
    body_sha256 CHAR(64) NOT NULL CHECK (body_sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
    source_refs TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (octet_length(source_refs) BETWEEN 2 AND 8192),
    applied_revision INTEGER CHECK (applied_revision BETWEEN 1 AND 2147483647),
    state_after TEXT CHECK (state_after IS NULL OR octet_length(state_after) BETWEEN 2 AND 8192),
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    PRIMARY KEY (activity_id,record_id),
    UNIQUE (activity_id,seq),
    UNIQUE (activity_id,business_key,ordinal),
    FOREIGN KEY (activity_id,business_key) REFERENCES teaching_commands(activity_id,business_key),
    FOREIGN KEY (activity_id,operation_id) REFERENCES activity_operation_results(activity_id,operation_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (activity_id,goal_record_id) REFERENCES teaching_records(activity_id,record_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (activity_id,parent_record_id) REFERENCES teaching_records(activity_id,record_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (activity_id,exercise_record_id) REFERENCES teaching_records(activity_id,record_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (activity_id,answer_record_id) REFERENCES teaching_records(activity_id,record_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (activity_id,supersedes_record_id) REFERENCES teaching_records(activity_id,record_id),
    CHECK ((kind IN ('path_proposal','exercise','calculation','feedback')
            AND operation_id IS NOT NULL AND body IS NULL)
        OR (kind NOT IN ('path_proposal','exercise','calculation','feedback')
            AND operation_id IS NULL AND body IS NOT NULL)),
    CHECK ((applied_revision IS NULL) = (state_after IS NULL)),
    CHECK ((kind = 'goal' AND goal_record_id IS NULL) OR
        (kind <> 'goal' AND goal_record_id IS NOT NULL)),
    CHECK (kind NOT IN ('feedback','calculation','progress') OR answer_record_id IS NOT NULL),
    CHECK (kind NOT IN ('answer','exposure','feedback','calculation','progress') OR exercise_record_id IS NOT NULL),
    CHECK (kind <> 'progress' OR parent_record_id IS NOT NULL)
);

 request_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(request_sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
 slot_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(slot_sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'), effect_applied BOOLEAN NOT NULL,
 before_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(before_revision BETWEEN 0 AND 2147483647),
 after_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(after_revision BETWEEN 1 AND 2147483647),
 after_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(after_version BETWEEN 1 AND 32),
 result_meta TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(octet_length(result_meta) BETWEEN 2 AND 4096),
 cleanup_manifest TEXT CHECK(cleanup_manifest IS NULL OR octet_length(cleanup_manifest) BETWEEN 2 AND 8192),
 manifest_sha256 TEXT CHECK(manifest_sha256 IS NULL OR manifest_sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),

CREATE TABLE public.learning_memory_dependencies(
 memory_id UUID NOT NULL, version INTEGER NOT NULL, ordinal SMALLINT NOT NULL CHECK(ordinal BETWEEN 1 AND 32),
 dependency_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(dependency_kind IN ('source','event','memory')),
 source_id UUID, source_version_id UUID, source_revision INTEGER CHECK(source_revision>=0), original_sha256 TEXT,
 origin_activity_id UUID, record_id UUID, record_kind TEXT, record_sha256 TEXT,
 origin_scope_revision INTEGER CHECK(origin_scope_revision>0), origin_goal_version INTEGER CHECK(origin_goal_version BETWEEN 1 AND 32),
 upstream_memory_id UUID, upstream_version INTEGER CHECK(upstream_version BETWEEN 1 AND 32), upstream_body_sha256 TEXT,
 PRIMARY KEY(memory_id,version,ordinal),
 FOREIGN KEY(memory_id,version) REFERENCES public.learning_memory_revisions(memory_id,version),
 FOREIGN KEY(source_id,source_version_id) REFERENCES public.material_versions(source_id,id),
 FOREIGN KEY(origin_activity_id,record_id) REFERENCES public.teaching_records(activity_id,record_id),
 FOREIGN KEY(upstream_memory_id,upstream_version) REFERENCES public.learning_memory_revisions(memory_id,version),
 CHECK(upstream_memory_id IS NULL OR upstream_memory_id<>memory_id),
 CHECK(original_sha256 IS NULL OR original_sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
 CHECK(record_sha256 IS NULL OR record_sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
 CHECK(upstream_body_sha256 IS NULL OR upstream_body_sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
 CHECK(record_kind IS NULL OR record_kind IN ('exercise','answer','feedback','progress','correction')),
 CHECK(
 (dependency_kind='source' AND num_nonnulls(source_id,source_version_id,source_revision,original_sha256)=4
  AND num_nonnulls(origin_activity_id,record_id,record_kind,record_sha256,origin_scope_revision,origin_goal_version,
   upstream_memory_id,upstream_version,upstream_body_sha256)=0)
 OR(dependency_kind='event' AND num_nonnulls(origin_activity_id,record_id,record_kind,record_sha256,
  origin_scope_revision,origin_goal_version)=6
  AND num_nonnulls(source_id,source_version_id,source_revision,original_sha256,
  upstream_memory_id,upstream_version,upstream_body_sha256)=0)
 OR(dependency_kind='memory' AND num_nonnulls(upstream_memory_id,upstream_version,upstream_body_sha256)=3
  AND num_nonnulls(source_id,source_version_id,source_revision,original_sha256,origin_activity_id,record_id,
   record_kind,record_sha256,origin_scope_revision,origin_goal_version)=0))
);

CREATE TABLE public.interview_commands (
 activity_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.activities(id), business_key uuid NOT NULL,
 action text NOT NULL CHECK(action IN ('start','goal','ask','answer','correct_answer','review','bind_scope','abandon','finish')),
 request_body text NOT NULL CHECK(octet_length(request_body) BETWEEN 1 AND 32768),
 request_sha256 text NOT NULL CHECK(request_sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
 semantic_slot text NOT NULL CHECK(semantic_slot ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
 execution_kind text NOT NULL CHECK(execution_kind IN ('local','model')),
 context_body text CHECK(octet_length(context_body) BETWEEN 1 AND 49152),
 context_sha256 text CHECK(context_sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
 operation_id text,
 status text NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('accepted','started','committed','history','not_sent','failed','unknown','abandoned')),
 launch_claimed boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false, obsolete boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
 effect_applied boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
 duplicate_of uuid, retry_of uuid,
 before_revision integer NOT NULL CHECK(before_revision BETWEEN 0 AND 2147483647),
 after_revision integer CHECK(after_revision BETWEEN 1 AND 2147483647),
 goal_version integer NOT NULL CHECK(goal_version BETWEEN 0 AND 32),
 scope_revision integer NOT NULL CHECK(scope_revision BETWEEN 1 AND 2147483647),
 result_record_ids uuid[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}' CHECK(cardinality(result_record_ids)<=2),
 error_code text CHECK(error_code ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9._:/-]{1,64}$'),
 created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
 PRIMARY KEY(activity_id,business_key), UNIQUE(activity_id,operation_id),
 FOREIGN KEY(activity_id,duplicate_of) REFERENCES public.interview_commands(activity_id,business_key),
 FOREIGN KEY(activity_id,retry_of) REFERENCES public.interview_commands(activity_id,business_key),
 CONSTRAINT interview_command_execution CHECK(
  (duplicate_of IS NOT NULL AND operation_id IS NULL AND context_body IS NULL AND context_sha256 IS NULL AND NOT effect_applied AND NOT launch_claimed)
  OR (duplicate_of IS NULL AND execution_kind='local' AND operation_id IS NULL AND context_body IS NULL AND context_sha256 IS NULL AND NOT launch_claimed)
  OR (duplicate_of IS NULL AND execution_kind='model' AND action IN ('ask','review') AND context_body IS NOT NULL AND context_sha256 IS NOT NULL
      AND operation_id='int10m.'||replace(business_key::text,'-',''))),
 CONSTRAINT interview_command_hash CHECK(encode(sha256(convert_to(request_body,'UTF8')),'hex')=request_sha256
      AND (context_body IS NULL OR encode(sha256(convert_to(context_body,'UTF8')),'hex')=context_sha256))
);

CREATE TABLE public.interview_records (
 activity_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.activities(id),record_id uuid NOT NULL,
 seq integer NOT NULL CHECK(seq BETWEEN 1 AND 4096),business_key uuid NOT NULL,ordinal integer NOT NULL CHECK(ordinal BETWEEN 0 AND 1),
 kind text NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('start','goal','scope','question','answer','probe','feedback','finish','abandon')),
 origin text NOT NULL CHECK(origin IN ('application','user','model')),
 goal_version integer NOT NULL CHECK(goal_version BETWEEN 0 AND 32),scope_revision integer NOT NULL CHECK(scope_revision BETWEEN 1 AND 2147483647),
 round_index integer NOT NULL CHECK(round_index BETWEEN 0 AND 4096),probe_depth integer NOT NULL CHECK(probe_depth BETWEEN 0 AND 4),
 answer_version integer CHECK(answer_version BETWEEN 1 AND 256),
 parent_ids uuid[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}' CHECK(cardinality(parent_ids)<=12),
 question_record_id uuid,supersedes_record_id uuid,
 source_refs jsonb NOT NULL CHECK(jsonb_typeof(source_refs)='array' AND jsonb_array_length(source_refs) BETWEEN 1 AND 10),
 body_sha256 text NOT NULL CHECK(body_sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
 local_body text CHECK(octet_length(local_body) BETWEEN 1 AND 32768),operation_id text,payload_sha256 text,
 created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
 PRIMARY KEY(activity_id,record_id),UNIQUE(activity_id,seq),UNIQUE(activity_id,business_key,ordinal),
 UNIQUE(activity_id,question_record_id,answer_version),
 FOREIGN KEY(activity_id,business_key) REFERENCES public.interview_commands(activity_id,business_key),
 FOREIGN KEY(activity_id,question_record_id) REFERENCES public.interview_records(activity_id,record_id),
 FOREIGN KEY(activity_id,supersedes_record_id) REFERENCES public.interview_records(activity_id,record_id),
 FOREIGN KEY(activity_id,operation_id) REFERENCES public.activity_operation_results(activity_id,operation_id),
 CONSTRAINT interview_record_storage CHECK((origin='model' AND kind IN ('question','probe','feedback') AND local_body IS NULL
    AND operation_id IS NOT NULL AND payload_sha256=body_sha256)
  OR (origin<>'model' AND local_body IS NOT NULL AND operation_id IS NULL AND payload_sha256 IS NULL
    AND encode(sha256(convert_to(local_body,'UTF8')),'hex')=body_sha256)),
 CONSTRAINT interview_answer_shape CHECK((kind='answer' AND origin='user' AND answer_version IS NOT NULL AND question_record_id IS NOT NULL)
  OR (kind<>'answer' AND answer_version IS NULL AND supersedes_record_id IS NULL))
);

CREATE TABLE public.html_preview_sessions(
 preview_id uuid PRIMARY KEY, activity_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.activities(id), artifact_id uuid NOT NULL,
 start_key uuid NOT NULL, generation integer NOT NULL CHECK(generation>0),
 artifact_sha256 text NOT NULL CHECK(artifact_sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
 owner_id uuid NOT NULL, owner_key_sha256 text NOT NULL CHECK(owner_key_sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
 control_key_sha256 text NOT NULL CHECK(control_key_sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
 boot_id uuid NOT NULL, nonce text NOT NULL CHECK(nonce ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
 image_id text NOT NULL CHECK(image_id ~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
 reserve_seconds integer NOT NULL CHECK(reserve_seconds BETWEEN 30 AND 60),
 elapsed_seconds integer CHECK(elapsed_seconds BETWEEN 0 AND 60),
 t0_ns bigint NOT NULL CHECK(t0_ns>0), deadline_ns bigint NOT NULL CHECK(deadline_ns>t0_ns),
 deadline_at timestamptz NOT NULL, cid text CHECK(cid ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
 state text NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('reserved','registered','start_requested','ready','running','stopping','stopped','failed_unstarted','cleanup_unconfirmed')),
 first_stop_receipt text CHECK(octet_length(first_stop_receipt) BETWEEN 2 AND 24576),
 confirmation_receipt text CHECK(octet_length(confirmation_receipt) BETWEEN 2 AND 24576),
 revision integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
 UNIQUE(activity_id,start_key), UNIQUE(activity_id,generation),
 FOREIGN KEY(activity_id,artifact_id) REFERENCES public.html_artifacts(activity_id,artifact_id),
 CHECK(deadline_ns=t0_ns+reserve_seconds::bigint*1000000000),
 CHECK((state IN ('stopped','failed_unstarted'))=(elapsed_seconds IS NOT NULL))
);
